scene: The rope swings you outside to Carnival Gate.
picture: On a level ground line, the tall Latino man in poncho and straw hat drops from a rope on the left. On the far left waits a glowing blue night bus. In the centre, a rickshaw cyclist rings a bell. On the far right stands a brass book cart lift with open metal gates.
shown: a blue night bus idling with doors open on the far left
a pedicab cyclist in a cap waving in the centre
a brass book cart lift with an open gate on the far right
